known_binance_regime_events.fact: USD-M perpetual contracts can automatically move from 8h/4h settlement to 1h after a settlement reaches its cap/floor; no separate announcement is required for each automatic adjustment.
known_binance_regime_events.lab_rule: Historical per-row funding_interval_hours metadata and timestamp occupancy, not the default schedule, determine whether BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT actually changed cadence.

known_binance_regime_events.fact: Binance changed the funding formula to divide the 8-hour formula by (8/N), where N is the funding interval, and changed the perpetual mark-price Price-2 moving-average basis from 1 minute to 30 seconds.
known_binance_regime_events.btc_eth_8h_scaling_implication: If V0.4.2 independently establishes N=8 for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, the formula divisor is 1, so the realized 8h settlement-rate scale remains one rate per 8h settlement. The regime boundary is nevertheless retained and must not be erased.
known_binance_regime_events.mark_price_implication: Historical mark-price observations remain direct observations but cross a documented calculation-regime boundary that must be recorded in later diagnostics.
